function.name: create_skill
function.description: Create a new skill for yourself when no skill in your index covers the work at hand. Write the skill as durable, reusable instructions (not a log of this task) so future runs can load and follow it. The skill joins your index immediately.

category.description: Optional grouping label, e.g. backend, qa, devops

content.description: Full step-by-step instructions in markdown, written to be followed verbatim on a future task

description.description: One line stating when to apply the skill — this is what the index shows

name.description: Short kebab-case skill name, e.g. terraform-state-recovery

tech_stack.description: Optional: the exact name of one of your tech stacks, when the skill only applies inside that technology. Omit for a general skill that holds whatever the code is written in.

function.name: load_skill
function.description: Load the full instructions of one of your skills by name or id. Call this right before applying a skill listed in your skill index, then follow the returned instructions.

skill.description: Skill name (from your skill index) or skill UUID
